scope: Nineteen exact architectural-clay models on one flat prepared site; eight local trial checks only. No new keeper or human approval.
authoring_provenance: Original placement: one normal UI duplex, 18 developer/API fixtures. This follow-up edited all 19 through ordinary reshape controls. Camera posing and transient synthetic occluder used developer debug hooks; exports and downloads used normal UI.
supersedes: Earlier unconfirmed download status: actual Windows download files match preview hashes. The old timeout was not a product download failure.
Earlier seven camera-limited entrance/contact views: resolved by scoped independent low/side reviews.
Earlier missing small/large and close/occluded evidence: supplied here without altering historical snapshots.
trial_corrections: Four initial readings sampled stale rebuild states or compared floating-point scale with strict equality. Successful retries waited for compiled state and used 1e-9 scale tolerance. Original readings retained.

Maximum square plot at 45 degrees exceeded the site edge for aquatic centre and library. Normal UI rejected this with the boundary message. Their maximum checks passed at zero degrees, then restored minimum plots at 15 degrees. Three rejected attempts retained.
Montreal occlusion receipt has one identical duplicate from a completed command timeout, counted once.
Cinema side-40 crops sign top; retained but not accepted for sign closure. side-40-complete supplies the full view.

console.scope: Normal export/edit/reload trial on tab 18; errors/warnings queried after final reload

test_instrumentation_warning.message: WARNING: Multiple instances of Three.js being imported.
test_instrumentation_warning.cause: Direct developer import for temporary foreground occlusion fixture; occurred before reload, fixture removed.

other_test_instrumentation_events: One browser command timeout completed without a download click; repeated bounded capture produced identical Montreal counts.
One screenshot receiver rejected JPEG bytes labelled PNG; saved successfully with JPEG extension. Not an application endpoint.

remaining_limits: Prepared flat site only; natural/sloped ground and every hidden contact are not certified.
Synthetic occluder tests capture depth behavior; natural tree/building occluders and paid AI fidelity are separate.
Walking through all interiors, accessibility, low-end laptops/iPads and 40 simultaneous sessions remain broader product trials.
Existing reviewed GLBs and local-trial publication flags are unchanged; exact-byte human activation and hosted staging remain separate.
All raw screenshots/downloads remain outside Git; source records retain their hashes and paths. No paid generation or deployment.

measurement_tolerances.purpose: Allow floating-point geographic projection and transform decomposition only; native dimension metadata remains exact.
